install_output_empty: Hapana chinobuda parizvino. Terminal mitsara kubva kuisa turusi ichaoneka pano.
linux_setup_title: Linux Inopenya & SP Flash Turusi Kugadzirisa
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kudhawunorodha uye kugadzirisa injini inopenya-kurumidza kuitira kuti ukwanise kudzorera uye kuvandudza mutambi wako pasina kushanda.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek chizvarwa chinopenya chigadzirwa chine raibhurari yepasi rose inoenderana yakaiswa.
linux_card_usb_desc: Inopa mvumo yekombiyuta yekutaura nemutambi mune Bootloader mode.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Turusi Sisitimu Yekuongorora & Kuongorora
system_checker_desc: Kuongororwa kwakadzama kwevatyairi, kernel modules, mvumo, uye maraibhurari enguva yekumhanya kuve nechokwadi chekuvimbika kupenya.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Inoita kuti kombiyuta yako igadzirire kubatanidza mutambi wako kuti ugadzirise software.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Inoongorora yakakwirira Linux yakaiswa ye SP Flash Tool, kuwana USB, mvumo ye serial, uye zvikamu zvehurongwa.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Inowana kombiyuta yako yakagadzirira kubatanidza mutambi wako uye kuisa software updates zvakavimbika.
settings_checker_desc: Inowana kombiyuta yako yakagadzirira kubatanidza mutambi wako uye kuisa software updates zvakavimbika.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kombiyuta yako yakagadzirira kubatanidza kune mutambi wako.
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Unogona kubatanidza mutambi wako kana uchibvunzwa.
linux_prep_blocked: kombiyuta iyi haikwanisi kumhanya SP Flash Turusi.
linux_prep_fix_body: Pasiwedhi yako inodiwa kamwe chete kuti uise kombiyuta iyi kuti ipenye: mitemo yeUSB yemidziyo yeMediaTek uye serial port access.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kuti uise kombiyuta iyi ye SP Flash Tool, password yako inozodiwa muchikamu chinoteera kugadzirisa mitemo ye USB uye kuwedzera akaundi yako kumapoka evashandisi ve serial anodiwa. Kana ukaramba, chikumbiro chinovhara.
linux_prep_needs_access: Kusvika kwainge kusina kupiwa, kupenya kunoda.
linux_prep_fixed: Kusvika kwakapihwa, SP Flash Turusi yakagadzirira.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kugadzirisa kwapera uye akaundi yako yakawedzerwa kumapoka evashandisi anodiwa nge SP Flash Tool. Ndapota tangazve kombiyuta yako kuti mvumo itsva ishande, wozovhurazve app. Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuongorora kuti uvhare app iye zvino.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Zvakaitwa, Vhara App kuti utangezve Kombiyuta
settings_driver_desc: Usati washandisa app iyi kekutanga, unofanira kuisa mutyairi we MediaTek USB, wozotangazve kombiyuta yako.
home_desc: Tsvaka firmware pamphepo kana kusarudza pakiti yemunharaunda, uye wozoipenya pamudziyo wako.
sel_source_desc: Dhawunorodha firmware pamphepo, kana kuendesa pasuru yemunharaunda.
settings_advanced_desc: Inokombidza kuisa nzira, kuisa mode uye kubudisa mafirita.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Iyo app inogara newe kuburikidza nekudzima simba, kubatanidza, uye kuisa.
settings_terminal_install: Isa kubva pane imwe terminal hwindo
settings_sp_gui_install: Isa mu SP Flash Turusi GUI .
settings_sp_gui_desc: Inovhara Updater CE uye inovhura SP Flash Tool GUI ine yakasarudzwa firmware inoparadzira faira uye mifananidzo yekuparadzanisa yakaiswa kare.
settings_terminal_desc: Inorumba software yako yekuisa muTerminal kuti uone ruzivo rwehunyanzvi pamusoro pekuenderera mberi.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Inorumba software yako yekuisa muCommand Prompt kuti uone ruzivo rwehunyanzvi pamusoro pekuenderera mberi.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Kusana. Vamweni vanangwa veMediaTek vanoramba kupenya kuguma SP Flash Tool yakapuwa faira rekugondisa (.auth); wedzera yako pano kana mudziyo uchida imwe.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Hapana faira rekuparadzira rakawanikwa mupakiti iyi, saka hapana murairo we console wakagona kuvakwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Hapana SP Flash Tool kuvaka kana MTKClient kupinda nzvimbo inowanikwa kune iyi nzira.
terminal_install_failed: Haana kukwanisa kuvhura hwindo rekupedzisira. Murairo wekuisa wakanyorwa kuti {path}.
status_terminal_install: Isa murairo wakavhurwa pahwindo rako rekupedzisira ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} zvino ichavhura kumhanya {method}.

• Kana isizi kutodzima, dzima magetsi {device} yako.
• Kana yakabatana ne USB, tanga yekuibvisa.
{hint}
• Batanidza mudziyo wako nekombiyuta yako kana {terminal_name} hwindo ravhurwa.

Dzvanya OK kuti utange uye kubuda Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Zano: Kana mudziyo usikazi kubatana ngekuzviita, dhinda bhatani re reset riri mu pinhole nge paperclip uchibatanidza tambo ye USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Zano: Isa mudziyo wako mu firmware download mode (inosiyana nge muenzaniso: e.g. bvisa bhatiri worichengeta kubanze nge tambo ye USB yakabatana, kana kudzima simba nge bhatiri mukati, kana kubata Volume Down/Up uchibatanidza USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Isa kuburikidza ne SP Flash Turusi GUI .
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Mudziyo GUI zvino ichavhura ne firmware yako yakaiswa kare.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, sarudza "Dhawunorodha" kubva mubhokisi rinodonha.
• Dzvanya bhatani rinonzi "Dhawunorodha".
• Iva nechokwadi chekuti {device} yako yakadzimwa uye yakadzimwa.
{hint}
• Batanidza tambo ye USB ku kombiyuta yako mushure mokunge wadhinda Download.

Dzvanya zvakanaka kuti utange SP Flash Turusi uye kubuda Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Kana yakabvumirwa, Rockbox themes inoendeswa pachayo kuY1 mushure mekubudirira kwekuisa Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Takanga tisingakwanisi kuisa themes pack pamutambi wako. Unokona kuedzazve kubva kuZvirongwa.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Kombidze Software yekutanga yakabudiswa yakare kudarika 3.0.7.
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Software yekutanga yakabudiswa yakakura kudarika 3.0.7 haienderani ne Y1 mayuniti anotengeswa nge Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kupenya chivakwa chekare pamayuniti aya kunozovadzivirira kuti vasatanga kusvikira itsva yakaiswazve.

Unogwinya ere kuti unoda kukhombise Original Software yakabudiswa yakare kudarika 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Inoratidza inovaka iyo ROM zip ndeye 240p yakasiyana (rom ... _240p.zip). 240p inovaka haina kuenderana neY1 mayuniti paInnioasis OS pazasi pe3.0.7, saka Kombidza Rockbox Yekare Inovaka inotenderwa nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Kubudiswa kwe Rockbox-Y1 isati yaguma 0.5 akuenderani ne Y1 mayuniti akatengeswa mushure mwaKurume 2026 ne Innioasis OS 3.0.7 isati yaiswa.

Kupenya kwekare kuvaka pamidziyo iyi kunodzivirira booting.

Unonyatsoziva kuti unoda kukhombisa Rockbox yekare inovaka?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Ndapota sarudza .zip, .rar archive, kana faira rekuparadzira (* kuparadzira * .txt) mukati me faira ye firmware kuti uise firmware yawakasarudza pa {target} yako.
sel_offline: Zvinyorwa zvepamhepo hazviwanikwi iye zvino. Shandisa faira remunharaunda, kana kutarisa kubatana kwako.
sel_no_release: Hapana kuburitswa kunowanikwa kune iyi software .
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Mapakeji akawanda e firmware kana mafaira akapararira akawanikwa mune iyi folda / archive. Ndapota sarudza faira kana dura rine pakiti imwe chete ye firmware panguwa imwe.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Kubudiswa uku kune faira rekuparadzira rinopfuura rimwe, saka Updater haikoni kuziva kuti ndeipi layout inodiwa ngemutambi wako. Mugadziri we {software} angada kugadzirisa kubudiswa kwavo kwe firmware kuti aite chete faira rimwe rekuparadzira.
sp_search_restart: Hapana mudziyo parizvino, kutsvaka zvakare (kuedza {count}). Ramba mutambi akadzima uye uibatanidze kana uchikurudzirwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Faira rekusimbisa harina kuwanika ({path}); kupenya pasina iyo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Faira rekuparadzira harizivise chikuva chayo, saka console configuration yefaira yekusimbisa haina kukwanisa kuvakwa; kupenya pasina iyo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Faira rekuparadzira harizivisi mhando yekuchengeta (EMMC / NAND / UFS), saka console yekugadzirisa yefaira yekusimbisa haina kukwanisa kuvakwa; kupenya pasina iyo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Hapana faira rekusimbisa rakapiwa; kupenya pasina imwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Haana kukwanisa kunyora faira rekugadzirisa kwe console; kupenya pasina faira rekusimbisa.
settings_notifications_desc: Kombidze zviziviso zvehurongwa hwechiziviso uye mhando dzekuvandudza pazasi. Off inochengeta zviro zveshe mukati mwe app.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Ita kuti zviziviso zvivepo kana app yakavharwa
settings_add_device_type_hint: Mhando ndiyo mutambi hardware kudzokorora. Vatambi vemuenzaniso umwe vanokona kuvakwa mukudzokorora kunopfuura kumwe — semuenzaniso Mhando A uye Mhando B — uye software inogadzirirwa imwe yavo. Tarisa chiratidzo chiri kumashure kwemutambi; kana isingadaidzi mhando, siya sarudzo yekutanga.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Hapana shanduro dziripo dze software iyi iye zvino.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Chengeta app mu menyu bar mushure mwekunge hwindo ravhara, saka uchiri kuwana app uye mutambi firmware update zviziviso. Off: kuvhara hwindo kunosiya app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Chengeta app mu system tray mushure mwekunge hwindo ravharwa, saka uchiri kuwana app uye mutambi firmware update zviziviso. Off: kuvhara hwindo kunosiya app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Hisha bhuku remunharaunda yepamphepo uye woisa software kubva kumafaira emunharaunda chete.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Iwe wakapenya 360p Rockbox kuvaka. Unode kuisa 360p Theme Pack pamudziyo uyu zvino ere?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Batanidza Mutambi mu USB Yekuchengetedza Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Ndapota bvisa USB, simba uye boot muRockbox kamwe (saka inotanga mukati mwayo .rockbox system folda), uye wozobatanidzazve USB uye sarudza 'USB Storage Mode'.

Kana yakabatana, baya Ramba uchisarudza chero faira pamutambi wako.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Sarudza chero faira pane yako yakabatana mutambi wekuchengetedza
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yakabudirira kuiswa pamudziyo wako!
sel_dialog_filter: Mafaira e Firmware (*.zip *.rar * kuparadzira*.txt *.txt);;Matura (*.zip *.rar);;Mafaira ekuparadzira (* kuparadzira*.txt *.txt);; Mafaira eshe (*.*)
sel_only_local: Sarudza .zip yemunharaunda kana .rar firmware pakiti, kana faira / kuparadzira .txt faira, yekuisa isiri paIndaneti, hapana internet inodiwa. Inoshanda ne Innioasis imwe neimwe uye Timmkoo mutambi wezwi.
sel_only_local_generic: Sarudza pakiti ye firmware yemunharaunda (.zip, .rar) kana faira rine faira rekuparadzira rekuisa pasina internet, inoshanda ngemidziyo yeMediaTek yakajairika.
sel_offline_install: Isa firmware kubva ku .zip kana .rar faira pane chero Innioasis kana Timmkoo mutambi wezwi.
sel_offline_install_generic: Isai chirongwa chekugadzira kubva ku .zip / .rar dura kana chirongwa chechirongwa pane midziyo yeMediaTek yakajairika.
sel_update_available: Pane update ku {software} inowanikwa kune yako {model}.
conn_offline: Uri kunze kweindaneti. Kuisa kubva kuNharaunda Firmware Archive hazviwanikwi.
conn_archive_unavailable: Iyo firmware bhuku iri kwenguva pfupi isingasviki. Unokwanisa kuisa kubva kune archive kana mafaira emunharaunda.
single_instance_body: Imweni kopi yakavhurika, kana kuti ichiri kushanda kumashure. Makopi maviri aizokwikwidzana ngekubatana kweUSB yemutambi, saka iyi haizotangi.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi inomhanya haina kupindura chikumbiro chekutaridza hwindo rayo. Inokona kunge yakabatikana kana yakasungirirwa. Kumanikidza kurega iyo kunovhiringidza chero chii zvacho chairi kuisa.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi iri kumhanya haina kukwanisa kupera. Siya iwe pachako, uye wotanga updater zvakare.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi inorumba iri kuisa software kana kubhuya nemutambi, saka kuipedza zvino zvinozovhiringidza izvozvo. Kuvhura uku kunozovhara; shandisa hwindo riripo kana menyu yaro bhaa icon kana kuisa kunopera.
notices_summary_body: Vhura Zviziviso mu app kuti uzviverenge.
toast_battery_charged: Usati washandisa izvi pamutambi wako, charge bhatiri kweawa imwe chete .
toast_battery_charged_device: Usati washandisa izvi pamudziyo wako, charge bhatiri kweawa imwe chete .
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Ita kuti zviziviso zvekumashure zvigamuchire kugadzirisa uye kubudisa zviziviso kunyange apo Updater yakavharwa kune menyu bar.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Ita kuti zviziviso zvekumashure zvigamuchire kugadzirisa uye kubudisa zviziviso kunyange apo Updater yakavharwa kune system tray.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Mabasa ekushandura epaIndaneti haasi kukwanisika kana kuti ari pa cooldown. Mapepa ekutanga ekubudiswa acharatidzwa panzvimbo.
translate_unavailable_hint: Kushandurirwa hakuwanikwi kwenguva pfupi. Tarisa internet yako kana kuedza zvakare gare gare.
sel_notes_hint: Sarudza kuburitswa kuti uone changelog yayo .
flash_wait_desc: Simba dzima mudziyo kutanga. Kana yakabatana asi isingaonekwi, edza tambo yakasiyana yeUSB kana port.
dialog_pre_install_header: Ndapota ita kuti {model} yako ive yakadzimwa uye isina kubatanidzwa neUSB .
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Dzima simba remudziyo wako zvachose usati watanga.
• Kana mudziyo wakaoma kana kuti usingadaviri, shandisa pini kana pepa riri mugomba rekugadzirisazve kuti umanikidze simba kudzima kuti riende mu download mode.
• Ramba wakadzima tambo ye USB kwezvino.
• Baya Continue, wozobatanidza mudziyo wako nge USB kana wakurudzirwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Kudzima zvakakwana simba rako MediaTek mudziyo.
• Ramba wakadzima tambo ye USB kwezvino.
• Zvichienderana ngemuenzaniso, edza kubatanidza kana pasina bhatiri rakaiswa (kana kubata Volume Down / Up uchibatanidza).
• Baya Continue, wozobatanidza tambo ye USB kana wabvunzwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Atikoni kuchengeta data yako yekuisa iyi ngekuti firmware yako yemazuwa ano haienderani ne Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Dusa tambo ye USB woshandisa paperclip kana pini kuti udzvanye bhatani rekugadzirisa, wozoedza kubatanidzazve.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Zvinokurukurwa kuti ubatanidze mutambi kune charger yemadziro kwemaminitsi makumi matatu kusvika paawa usati waedza kubatanidza.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Kana uri paWindows, ita kuti uve nechokwadi chekuti wakaisa Vatyairi.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Windows PCs dzinofanira kutangazve mushure mokuisa mutyairi asati atanga kushandiswa.
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Software yacho yakatoiswa pa {model} yako ere?
install_first_which_firmware: Ndeipi software iri kushanda pa {model} yako?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Kana usina chokwadi, sarudza 'Imweni' kana software yaunofunga kuti yakaiswa.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kuti uenderere mberi nekuisa uku, ndapota simbisa kana {model} yako yatoshandisa software inodiwa yepasi ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Tinokona kuchengeta marongero ako uye midhiya chete apo mutambi atoshandisa software iyi kana shanduro inoenderana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Tinokona kuchengeta zvirongwa zvako chete kana mutambi atoshandisa software iyi kana kuti inoenderana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Tinokona kuchengeta marongero ako uye midhiya chete apo mutambi atoshandisa software iyi kana shanduro inoenderana.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Bvumidza Ramba Zvirongwa uye Midhiya pane chero firmware kuisa
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Inosvetuka mubvunzo wekuenderana. Shandisa izvi zvega kana uine chokwadi chekuti mutambi acharamba achishanda nemarongero ayo emazuwa ano uye midhiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Haana kukwanisa kuchengeta zvirongwa zvako uye vezvenhau: faira ye firmware haina kunyorwa. Apana chiro chakaiswa.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Inochengeta marongero ako uye vezvenhau pamutambi. Zvimwe zvese zve software zvinoiswa semazuva ese.
flash_keep_data_warning: Kana ukaenderera mberi pasina izvi, marongero ako uye midhiya inozogadziriswazve pane yekuchengeta yemukati yemutambi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Kuti ukaenderera mberi usina izvi, mathemes ako eRockbox, mafonti nemarongero anozobviswa. Mimhanzi yako nedzimwe nhau dzinogara pamutambi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Kuti ukaenderera mberi usina izvi, mathemes ako eRockbox, mafonti nemarongero anozobviswa, uye kuchengetedza kwemukati kwemutambi kunozogadziriswazve.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Kana ukaenderera mberi pasina izvi, zvirongwa zvako zvichagadziriswazve. Mimhanzi yako nedzimwe nhau dzinogara pamutambi.
format_all_data_warning_y1: firmware iyi inofanira kugadzirisa zvakare mutambi wekuchengetedza mukati. Zvirongwa zvakachengetedzwa zvichadzimwa; mimhanzi yako uye dzimwe nhau dzichagara munzvimbo.
format_all_data_warning_other: firmware iyi inofanira kugadzirisa zvakare mutambi wekuchengetedza mukati. Zvirongwa zvakachengetedzwa uye midhiya yakachengetwa pane yakagadzirwa-mukati yekuchengeta inozodzimwa. Midhiya pa microSD yako inogara munzvimbo.
format_all_confirm_body:
Kune {software} tinoda kugadzirisa zvakare {model} yako yekuchengeta mukati tisati taenderera mberi. Pasurepo imweni SP Flash Tool kuedza inozoedzwa, asi muFomati Zveshe + Dhawunorodha maitiro kuburikidza ne XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Dzura USB, wozoisa pepa kana pini mu reset pinhole pa {model} yako. Dzvanya Inotevera kuti uedze zvakare muFomati Zvese + Dhawunorodha mode.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yakashuma kuti tafura yekuparadzanisa yemutambi yakachinja (8502). Firmware iyi inofanira kuiswa mune Format All + Download mode, iyo inogadzirisa zvakare kuchengetedza kwemukati.
install_first_hint: Usati waisa {target} kekutanga, {model} yako inofanira kunge yeishanda {software} — kana {target} pachayo, kana yakatoiswa uye ichishanda.
install_first_version_fmt: {model} yako yatokwanisa kuita zvinodiwa nge {software} ({version}) ere?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Ndapota bvisa USB, simba pa {model} yako uye dzvanya Inotevera.
install_first_power_on_hint: Rega mutambi atange kamwe chete pa firmware yepasi, uye wozodzima simba kuti iise inotevera.
install_first_need_body: {software} ndiyo yepasi yekambani ye {target}. Inozoiswa pa {model} yako kutanga, yozotevera {target} yomene. Ramba mutambi akabatanidzwa uye usaibvisa.
install_first_when_body: {target} haifaniri kuiswa yakananga pamusoro pe {running}: pa {model} yako mutambi haazotangi zvakanaka mushure mwazvo. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo njira yakachengeteka, uye {target} inozotevera yega. Ramba mutambi akabatanidzwa uye usaibvisa.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} haifaniri kuiswa zvakananga pamusoro pe software iripo kare pa {model} yako: mutambi haazotangi zvakanaka mushure mwazvo. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo njira yakachengeteka, uye {target} inozotevera yega. Ramba mutambi akabatanidzwa uye usaibvisa.
install_first_recommend_body: {model} yako iri kumhanya {running}. Kuisa {target} pamusoro payo kunokona kuchengeta {running}'s kutanga logo uye tsika mudziyo logos. Kuisa {software} kutanga ndiyo njira yakachena: {target} yozotevera yega. Ehe inoisa {software} kutanga; Hapana inoisa {target} zvino ine magadzirirwo matsva uye midhiya.
install_first_missing: Firmware iyi inoda {software} kutanga, asi bhuku harina kubudiswa kunoiswa kwe {software}.
install_first_version_unavailable: Firmware iyi inoda {software} {version}, asi hapana kubudiswa mubhuku rinoenderana nezvinodiwa.
install_first_needs_answer: Firmware iyi inoda kuongororwa kwe firmware yepasi, iyo inoda chiteshi chinopindirana.
keep_data_microsd_reassurance: Midhiya yako pa microSD yako inogara iri munzvimbo .
keep_data_erase_prompt_y1: Isa uye dzima zvirongwa pa {model} yako?

support_story_1_lead: Kudzivirira mudziyo wako kubva kunyarara hardware misungo uye yakaputsika kudzokorora.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis inogara yeibudisa firmwares itsva dzevatambi vakadai nge Y1 (inotarisa kudzokorora kwebhodhi rakafishika kudai nge 6.0, 7.0, ne 8.0) iyo inoparadza midziyo yekare zvinyararire. Zvakanyanya kuipa, webhusaiti yavo inopa zero yambiro uye zero kupinda kune yakapfuura kushanda firmwares kupora kubva kune zvidhinha nyika. Updater CE uye Community Firmware project inotora zvikamu: tinochengeta nhaka imwe neimwe ye ROM, tinozviongorora pachayo hardware yako yekudzokorora, uye tinochengeta mutambi wako achimhanya zvakanaka.

support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Kuona bhodhi otomatiki kuti ugare uchiwana pakiti yakakodzera.
support_story_2_headline: Hapana yakaputsika Google Dhiraivha. Apana mushando wekufembera. Kungoshanda firmware.
support_story_2_lead: High-speed, yakasimbiswa nharaunda zvivakwa iwe unogona kunyatsovimba.
support_story_2_body: Kutsvaka pasi Innioasis software yepamutemo inowanzoreva kutsvaira maforamu eGoogle Drive yakapera nguva, yakafa Baidu gore zvikamu, uye mafaira zip asizi kujeka asina zvishandiso zvinopenya. Takaaka nzvimbo inovimbika, yakazvimirira yekudzikinura ine SHA-256 yakasimbiswa kuvimbika, zviziviso zvekugadzirisa, uye nhanho-nhanho inotungamirirwa nekuisa. Mipiro yenyu inochengeta zvakananga zviro zvinotorwa no kugamuchira zvinoita kuti izvi zvikwanisike maawa 24 pa zuwa, mazuva 365 pa gore.

support_story_3_headline: Kuvhura zvakakwana zvinokwanisika zve Innioasis yako mutambi.
support_story_3_lead: Kuunze Rockbox, tsika dzisingaremi dzekushandisa masisitimu, uye rusununguko rwevateereri.
support_story_3_body: Stock fekitari software inongotsvaira pamusoro pezvinoitwa ngeY1 kana Y2 yako hardware. Nharaunda yedu yakaunza Rockbox, masisitimu ekushandisa akareruka, kutamba kwe audiophile codec, uye mafungiro etsika kuhupenyu. Tinotenga midziyo yenyama yakasiyana-siyana kunze-kwehomwe kuti tiedze, kudzosa injiniya, uye kuongorora imwe neimwe yekuisa. Kutsigira Updater CE zvakananga inopa mare aya mayuniti ekuedza uye inokurumidza kuvandudza firmware yetsika.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox imwe-Click: Kutamba kwe Audiophile uye mafungiro etsika akaiswa mumasekonzi.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware yemunharaunda: Kusimudzira kwebhatiri, UI yakachena, uye yemazuwa ano inotsigira codec yemazwi.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Tinoedza pazviro zvemene zvenyama tisati tabudisa chero chivakwa.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yemahara, yakavanzika-yekutanga software isina zvishambadzo kana kutevera.
support_story_4_lead: Nharaunda-yakasimba firmware kuchengetedza midziyo yako kure nemarara.
support_story_4_body: Kana kambani ye hardware inoenda kune imwe gadget yavo inotevera, mhando dzekare dzinosiiwa. Innioasis haipe rubatsiro rweLinux, hapana changelogs yakajeka, uye hapana nzira iri nyore yekupora kana kuisa kusingakwanisi. Updater CE iripo ngekuti vashandisi vanoshingaira havafaniri kurasa mutambi wemimhanzi yakanaka zvakakwana. 100% yemipiro yenharaunda inoenda zvakananga mukuchengeta chirongwa ichi chakavhurika kune munhu weshe.

support_story_4_item_4: 100% Nharaunda Inobhadharwa: Kofi imwe neimwe inochengeta ndau yekuchengeta zviro yakavhurika uye isingabhadhari kune veshe.

retry_guidance_intro: Kubatana kweUSB kune mutambi wako kwamira kupindura. Mutambi wako anoda bhuku reset asati imwe kuedza inogona kushanda.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Bvisa tambo ye USB kubva kumutambi wako.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Dhinda yakavanzika reset bhatani nepini, pepa kana nzeve.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Isa tambo ye USB zvakare mukati, uye wozoedza zvakare.

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Isa iyo yakasarudzwa system software pane yako mudziyo .
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Mudziyo wakagadzirwa nge libpng12 kuenderana.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Dzvanya Re-ongorora kana kutangazve kugadzirisa kuti utore pakiti.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: MediaTek mitemo inoshanda (/ nezvimwewo / udev / mitemo.d /). Kuwana kwedesktop kwakabvumirwa.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Ipa mvumo kamwe chete kuti app ikwanise kutaura nemudziyo wako.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Mvumo ye USB & mitemo ye udev yakaiswa zvakanaka. Mabasa akarongwa.
donate_rely_on_you: Tidetsere nge mare yetinoshandisa, donate nyamashi.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vhura MediaTek SP Flash Turusi GUI .
status_app_reset_defaults: App yakagadziriswa zvakare kune yakagara iripo, kudhawunorodha cache yakabviswa, uye bhatiri yekuyeuchidza yakadzoserwa.
log_app_reset_defaults: Kurongeka kweapp kwakagadziriswa zvakakwana kune yakagara iripo, kurodha cache yakabviswa, uye bhatiri yekuyeuchidza yakadzoserwa (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Ramba wakaiisa mukati, Rockbox iri kutanga uye mathematics ayo anozowedzerwa pachayo.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Tarisa kuti yakasungirirwa uye yakasvibiswa. Kana zvakaramba zvakasvipa, dzvanya pini mugomba rekugadzirisa uye ubate bhatani repakati (Y1) kana bhatani remasimba (vamwe vatambi) kuti utangezve. Kana zvichiri hazvizotanga, firmware haana kutora, kuisa imwe.
action_flash_complete: Flash yakapera! Dzura USB uye utange zvakare.
action_recover_powercycle: Simba-kutenderera mutambi (bata simba ~ 10s), uye wozoibatanidza zvakare - kuedza zvakare ...
action_wait_mtk: Kumirira mudziyo weMTK ... Simba remudziyo uye kubatanidza USB.
action_da_stall: Mudziyo wakasiya kudaira apo uchigadzirisa mumiririri wekurodha. Simba iri dzima zvachose, batanidza zvakare, uye edza zvakare.
action_detected_brom: Mudziyo wakaonekwa (BROM mode) - kugadzirisa mumiririri wekudzikinura ...
action_detected_preloader: Mudziyo wakaonekwa (preloader mode) - kunasirisa mumiririri wekurodha...
action_da_wait_back: Mutambi akasiya kupindura apo achitanga mumiririri wekurodha. Kuemera kuti zvipetuke...
log_install_writing: Isai mukuenderera mberi - kunyora mifananidzo ye firmware ...
log_sparse_fmt: Detected Android sparse image for {part}, converting in-process...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kuparadzanisa tafura kuongororwa kwakakundikana mushure mekunyora .
err_sp_wrong_model: Iwe wakabatanidza muenzaniso wakaipa wemutambi. Dzvanya bhatani re × kuti ubvise kuisa uku, wozosarudza software yemutambi wawakabatanidza.
err_sp_timeout: Iyo turusi haina kumboona mutambi. Ramba wakadzima uye wakabvisa, wozobatanidza tambo ye USB kana wakurudzirwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mutambi akasimudza simba mangwanani maningi. Simba iri dzima zvachose, uye wozoibatanidza zvakare.
err_sp_download_fail: Kunyora kwakavhiringidzwa. Tarisa tambo yeUSB uye port uye bhatiri rinobhadhara, uye wozoedza zvakare.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Mumiririri wekurodha haana kukwanisa kutanga. Edza imwe nzira yekupenya.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Mumiririri wekurodha haana kukwanisa kutumirwa kune mutambi. Dzima simba uye ubatanidze zvakare.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Mutambi akaramba mumiririri wekurodha (kukanganisa 6104). Shandisai Mumiririri wo Kudhirowa wakabatana no SP Flash Tool, movona kuti firmware inoenderana no mutambi uwu.
err_sp_com_port: Iyo turusi haina kukwanisa kuvhura chiteshi chayo serial. Vhara mamwe maturusi anopenya uye ubatanidze zvakare.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Iyo USB COM port haina kukwanisa kuvhurwa (kukanganisa 1013). Kutangazve kombiyuta yako kunobudisa chiteshi chakavharwa. Ndapota tangazve kombiyuta yako uye edza zvakare.
err_sp_enable_dram: Turusi harina kukwanisa kutanga ndangariro mutambi. Shandisa pakiti yakavakwa kuti iyi chaiyo muenzaniso.
err_sp_storage_read: Turusi harina kukwanisa kuverenga mutambi kuchengetera. Tarisa kuti kubatana kwakadini; mudziyo unogona kunge une mhosva ye hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Turusi rinopenya rakanga risina kuenderera mberi mukati me {seconds} masekonzi, saka kuedza uku kwakaemeswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Haana kukwanisa kugadzira kubatana kwakagadzikana nemutambi. Ivai nechokwadi chekuti mudziyo wakadzimwa (shandisa pini kuti mutsinye bhatani rekugadzirisa kana zvichidikanwa), bvisa USB, uye mubatanidzezve kana mwakumbirwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kupenya kwakavhiringidzwa kana kuti kunyora oparesheni yakakundikana. Ningira kuti tambo ye USB yakasungirirwa zvakanaka ere uye kuti bhatiri rine simba rakakwana, wozozamazve.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Chiro chinopenya chakakhombise mutsara umwewo kwemasekonzi ekupedzisira {seconds} uye hachioneki sechienderera mberi nekunyora firmware. Flash inokona kunge yakakundikana. Kana izvi zvainge zviri zvekupeisira zvekuedza mairi ngenjira imwe neimwe pane system inokona kudzoka pakati pavo, kana kuti MTKClient yega iripo pamushini uyu, tangazve kombiyuta uye edzazve.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient chete ndiyo inowanikwa yekuisa iyi. Flash inokona kunge yakakundikana. Ndapota tangazve kombiyuta uye edza zvakare.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: kombiyuta iyi inogonawo kuisa uchishandisa SP Flash Tool. Kana uchikwanisa, chinja kune SP Flash Tool uye edza zvakare.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash inokona kunge yakakundikana. Ndapota verenga mashoko ari pamusoro uye utangezve kombiyuta usati waedza zvakare. Kana ukadhinda OK, app inozosiya kuti ukwanise kutangazve.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iyo firmware pakiti inoshayikwa faira rekuparadzira kana inodiwa mafaira emifananidzo. Ndapota rodha zvakare pakiti kana kusarudza faira yakakwana ye firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Faira rekusimbisa rawakasarudza haripo, risina chinhu kana kuti harina kukwanisa kunyorwa. Sarudza faira rinoshanda, kana kuibvisa muZvirongwa, wozopenyazve.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: The kupenya turusi kana zvinodiwa hurongwa vatyairi havana kukwanisa initialized. Ndapota ningirai mvumo ye system, kuisa mutyairi, kana kuisazve chirongwa.
err_driver_missing_desc: Kukanganisa uku kunokona kuitika kana mutyairi weMediaTek USB asina kuiswa. Dzvanya Download Vatyairi kuti uise mutyairi weMediaTek USB, utangezve kombiyuta yako, uye edza zvakare.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Faira re firmware rakachengetwa haripo. Sarudza Sarudza Software kuti uvakezve mafaira akabudiswa kana kutora firmware archive zvakare. Iyi idambudziko refaira remunharaunda, kwete nyaya yekubatanidza USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Petuka kune Sarudza Software kuti uvakezve kana kurodha pakiti ye firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Sarudza kuburitswa kwe firmware kuti utore zvakare.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kukanganisa kusingatarisirwi kwakaitika panguva yekuisa ({detail}). Dzima mutambi zvachose, batanidza zvakare kana wakurudzirwa, uye edza zvakare.
flash_method_confirm: Isa nzira yakachinjwa kuva {method}. Iva nechokwadi chekuti mutambi akabviswa uye akadzimwa, uye wobva wadzvanya Zvinotevera.
flash_failover_note: {method} haana kuwana kuisa kutanga. Mushure mwekunge mutambi adzimwa uye abviswa, {other} inozoshandiswa panzvimbo yayo.
themepack_card_desc: Inosanganisira mazwi akanaka enharaunda, mafoni ane resolution yakakwirira, uye mafonti akagadzirwa zvakananga kuti aratidze 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Nhanho 1: Batanidza mu USB Yekuchengetedza Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Tungamidza mutambi wako nekubata bhatani reSimba.
2. Kana Rockbox yatanga, isa tambo yeUSB mukombiyuta yako.
3. Kana akakurudzirwa pamusoro mutambi skrini, simbisa USB Storage mode saka mudziyo unooneka semutyairi.
themepack_step2_title: Nhanho 2: Sarudza Chero Folda pane Mutambi .
themepack_step2_desc: Ngekuti masisitimu anoshanda (akadai nge macOS) anoviga dotfiles (akadai nge .rockbox) ngekugara, unokona kusarudza chero faira kana nzira yemuchovha pamutambi wako. Tichazviwana kana kugadzira .rockbox dhairekitori kwauri.
themepack_complete: Theme pack yakabudirira kuiswa! Iwe zvino unokwanisa kudzima mutambi wako zvakachengeteka uye kusarudza musoro muRockbox (Zvirongwa> Zvirongwa zveMusoro).
themepack_err_not_found: Haana kukwanisa kuwana kana kutanga .rockbox dhairekitori pane yakasarudzwa drive. Ndapota iva nechokwadi chekuti wakasarudza faira pamutambi wako.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Danho 1: Tangazve mutambi uye ubatanidze zvakare
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Bvisa tambo ye USB.
2. Simba mutambi zvakare pamusoro uye regai boot muRockbox.
3. Kana Rockbox iri kushanda, batanidzazve tambo yeUSB, wobva wadzvanya Enderera.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Iyo app iri kuona kuti ADB inobatana (kusvika kumasekonzi makumi matatu). Kana mudziyo ukawanikwa, themes dzinoendeswa uye mutambi rebooted otomatiki. Zvikasadaro, pfuura mberi kune USB Kuchengetedza Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kumirira mudziyo weADB ... (kusvika kumasekonzi makumi matatu)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Hapana mudziyo weADB wakaonekwa mukati memasekonzi makumi matatu; kuenderera mberi ne USB Kuchengetedza Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Hapana ADB binary inowanikwa kune app; kuenderera mberi ne USB Kuchengetedza Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB kuendesa kwakakundikana; kudzokera kumashure kune USB Yekuchengetedza Mode .
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Isa kuburikidza ne USB Yekuchengetedza Mode .
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Ita kuti USB yekuchengetedza Mode pamutambi saka inoita semutyairi.
2. Sarudza CHERO faira pamutambi uri pashi (.rockbox, Mimhanzi, Themes, kana nzira yekutyaira, yakavanzika .rockbox faira inowanikwa yega).
3. Iyo app inosanganisa 360p themes uye mafonti mukati, kunyora mafaira ezita rimwe chete.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Iwe zvino unokwanisa kudzima mutambi zvakachengeteka uye kusarudza musoro muRockbox (Zvirongwa> Zvirongwa zveMusoro).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software yako itsva yakaiswa, asi .rockbox folda yekare haina kukwanisa kubviswa. Dzima .rockbox folda pamutambi ngenyara kana uchida kutanga kwakachena.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Vatambi vanopfuura mumwe chete vakabatana. Dzura dzimwe uye siya chete imwe iri kuiswa.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Mutambi akaonekwa. Kuisa mathematics enharaunda & mafonti ...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Bata bhatani repakati kuti uise simba paY1 yako, ubatanidzezve USB, uye sarudza USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Bata bhatani remagetsi kuti uise simba pamutambi wako, ubatanidzezve USB, uye sarudza USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Mudziyo hauna kutanga? Dzorerai software yekutanga .
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Ndapota dzima uye simba pa {model} yako, uye wobva wadzvanya Zvinotevera .
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Dzura USB, bata {button} kuti uise simba pa {model} yako, wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Ndapota ita kuti USB yekuchengetedza mode pane yako uye tinya Inotevera .
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Ndapota ita kuti USB yekuchengetedza mode pane yako {model}, uye sarudza drive inooneka .
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Ndapota sarudza mutambi pachake kana imwe yemafaira ari pairi .
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Dzura USB uye simba paY1 yako, uye wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Dzura USB uye simba pa {model} yako, uye wobva wadzvanya Next.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Rockbox iri kushanda pa {model} yako ere?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Sarudza 'USB Kuchengetedza Mode' pamutambi wako.
2. Dzvanya 'Browse Folder ...' kuti usarudze mutambi wako uye kuisa themes.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Rockbox iyi inoaka inoshandisa 240 × 320 themes, dzisina kusanganiswa. Tsvaka themes dzemahara dzemutambi wako kubva kuRockbox theme saiti:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Kana {model} yako isingavhuri, bvisa USB, bata bhatani remagetsi kwema 10s kuti uisezve, uye magetsi aripo. Kana kudzorera software yekutanga.
err_storage_full_desc: Kombiyuta yako yapera nzvimbo yekuchengeta. Ndapota sunungura nzvimbo ye disk pane drive yako uye edza zvakare.
